title: Project Limitations
lede: Deliberate architectural boundaries, computational constraints, and out-of-scope factors identified in the research design.

items.title: 2D Discrete Grid Representation
items.detail: The simulation operates on a discrete 25x25 tile grid rather than continuous physical vector space. Spatial orientation is restricted to cardinal directions (North, South, East, West).

items.title: Turn-Based Synchronous Execution
items.detail: Simulations advance through discrete steps and weekly phases rather than real-time continuous physics simulation. Actions are resolved in strict turn order based on agility and initiative.

items.title: Fixed Network Topology
items.detail: The MLP uses a static layer structure (41 inputs, 16 hidden, 12 hidden, 8 outputs). Neuroevolution modifies synaptic weights and biases only; topological mutation (NEAT) is outside project scope.

items.title: Static Population Bounds
items.detail: Generations maintain fixed starting population sizes. Intra-generational mating does not spawn immediate active agents; reproduction is handled globally at generation boundaries.

items.title: Local Sensory Horizon
items.detail: Animal perception is strictly bounded to the immediate 3x3 grid around its coordinate position. Organisms lack global map knowledge unless navigated to previously visited coordinates.

items.title: Deterministic Physical Bounds
items.detail: Biomes and terrain properties adhere to discrete lookup tables for movement costs and sickness probabilities rather than complex micro-climate simulation models.
